title: execute_command
description: Execute a command on the Flipper Zero device. All file operations, device queries, hardware control, and artifact pushes go through this interface. Mirrors com.vesper.flipper.domain.model.ExecuteCommand.

action.description: The action to perform on the Flipper Zero

args.description: Arguments for the action (varies by action type). Unused fields may be omitted.

key.description: Required for input_send: GUI key; uses the RPC input path with current risk approval.

press_type.description: For input_send: event type; omitted/null defaults to short in the executor.

signal_id.description: Required for loader_signal: nonnegative application signal ID. Loader control is one-shot USB CLI only; unavailable while RPC is active or streaming stop is uncertain.

command.description: Free-form command string. For execute_cli: the CLI command. For search_faphub/github_search/search_resources: the query. For install_faphub_app: the app id or name. For forge_payload: fallback natural-language prompt. For launch_app: fallback app name. For run_runbook: fallback runbook id. For browse_repo: fallback repo id. For audit_query: optional exact audit action type filter. For load_skill: bundled methodology ID (read-only; grants no execution approval).

path.description: File or directory path on Flipper (e.g., /ext/subghz/garage.sub). Also the source path for move/copy/rename, target path for push_artifact/download_resource, and signal file for subghz_transmit/ir_transmit/nfc_emulate/rfid_emulate/ibutton_emulate/badusb_execute.

content.description: Content to write to file (write_file), or BLE characteristic bytes/text (ble_write_char; encoding controlled by hex). Optional loader_signal argument, rejecting newline, carriage return, NUL, semicolon, pipe and ampersand. Also used as fallback for execute_cli. Catalog installation does not accept a direct URL override.

recursive.description: Whether to delete recursively (for delete action)

artifact_type.description: Type of artifact being pushed (for push_artifact action)

payload_type.description: Type of payload to generate (for forge_payload action)

app_args.description: Arguments passed to the launched app; also used as the ble_spam mode string

frequency.description: Reserved metadata; file-based SubGHz transmission uses the frequency stored in the file, not this field

protocol.description: Reserved metadata; file-based transmit/emulation uses the protocol stored in the file, not this field

address.description: Phone BLE target MAC address, required for enumerate/read/write/subscribe. File-based radio transmit/emulation uses the address stored in the file, not this field

signal_name.description: Named signal for IR transmit operations

enabled.description: On/off state (for vibro_control action; defaults to true)

sub_path.description: Sub-path within a browsed repo (for browse_repo action)

download_url.description: Direct resource URL for download_resource. Catalog install uses an exact application ID via command and a verified compatible build; URL overrides are not accepted.

search_scope.description: GitHub search scope, e.g. "code" or "repositories" (for github_search action; defaults to "code")

photo_prompt.description: Prompt describing what to capture (for request_photo action)

duration.description: Phone BLE actions: seconds, default 5, range 0.5..60. Scan/listen duration for scan/subscribe; connection and operation timeout for enumerate/read/write. Subscription connection timeout is 10 seconds; restoration adds at most 3 seconds.

uuid.description: Full characteristic UUID required for BLE read/write/subscribe; must identify exactly one characteristic instance.

hex.description: ble_write_char encoding: true (default) means hexadecimal byte pairs; false means UTF-8 text. Maximum 512 bytes.

with_response.description: ble_write_char only: true (default) waits for a GATT response. False sends without a peripheral response and rejects data exceeding negotiated MTU minus 3; no fragmentation.

target.description: Required nonblank target for vuln_submit (maximum 512 characters); optional Unicode case-insensitive target substring for current-session vuln_list.

vuln_type.description: Required vulnerability type for submit/classify (maximum 128 characters). Classification uses exact normalized rule keys; with vuln_id it must match the stored finding type.

description.description: Required nonblank finding description for vuln_submit, maximum 8192 characters.

evidence.description: Required nonblank observed evidence for vuln_submit, maximum 65536 characters. Submission does not establish reproduction.

severity.description: Required for vuln_submit or optional exact filter for vuln_list: critical/high/medium/low.

vuln_id.description: Required current-session finding ID for vuln_validate; optional for vuln_classify. ID-targeted classification persists severity and requires explicit approval.

reproduced.description: Required for vuln_validate: true confirms; false marks inconclusive and preserves earlier history.

notes.description: Optional validation notes, maximum 8192 characters. History is capped at 100 entries and 64 KiB of JSON; full histories reject mutation.

limit.description: audit_query maximum returned entries: 1..100, default 20. Always scoped to the calling session.

risk_level.description: Optional audit_query risk filter: LOW/MEDIUM/HIGH/BLOCKED, case-insensitive.

pin.description: Required for GPIO actions: MCU pin name matching P[A-H][0-9]{1,2}, for example PA7. Requires explicitly selected and confirmed USB CLI; verify physical wiring.

value.description: Required gpio_set value: 0 or 1. Typed hardware action uses one USB CLI send after normal risk approval.

mode.description: Required gpio_mode value: 0 or 1 according to firmware CLI. Confirm firmware semantics before changing hardware mode.

key_type.description: Required rfid_write key type: 1..32 letters, digits, underscore or hyphen. Firmware must support the requested type.

key_data.description: Required rfid_write key bytes: 1..32 hexadecimal byte pairs, no separators. Explicit confirmed USB CLI only; no retries.
